title: A lane subagent whose PR merged and whose worktree ship removed may end without a BLOCKER line
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 five lanes (#844 #845 #846 #847 #848) merged through bin/krn pr ship, which removes the lane worktree and branch; the SubagentStop hook added by t-07p7k0y (#839) then evaluated the main checkout on main, found no new commit and refused the end, so each lane had to print 'BLOCKER:' although it succeeded. That mislabels every successful lane as blocked and costs a turn.
Outcome: the Stop hook accepts a krn-lane subagent end when its cwd is the main checkout on the base branch and the lane's ship merged (e.g. the last assistant message carries 'verdict: merged <sha>' and that sha is on origin/main, or a ship receipt under .krn/ names it); a lane without a merged ship is still refused.
Proof: test/hook/stop.test.ts feeds a captured SubagentStop payload with agent_type krn-lane, cwd = repo root on main, last message 'verdict: merged <sha>' with sha on the base: exit 0; same without the verdict: exit 2.
